A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''enforcer''' worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. When rumors that the [[Guiding Hand]] gang was led by a Jedi reached the Cartel, the enforcer was sent to confront [[Tharan Cedrax]], who had been seen working with a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Knight]].
